rulings.restated: Enter the amount from div helper "Zero only after distribution scope checks".
rulings.model: IRS line 1 asks for 'the total of all collectibles gain or (loss) from items you reported on Form 8949, Part II'. The program enters $0, and none of the helper's refusals names Form 8949 collectibles sales. The text given does not show whether the distribution-only path is limited to filers with no such sales.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. Collectibles gain or loss on Form 8949 Part II is refused at the transaction: `sales.one` refuses when `sales.special` ("Direct sales of collectibles, section 1202 stock and section 1250 property are unsupported"), and the refusal reaches Form 1040 line 7a through `sd.count`. Line 1 is zero only behind that refusal. No change to the data.

rulings.model: IRS line 3 asks for collectibles gain or (loss) 'from Form 4684, line 4 ...; Form 6252; Form 6781, Part II; and Form 8824'. The program enters $0, and no refusal names those forms. The text does not show that the path excludes them.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. Forms 4684, 6252, 6781 and 8824 are refused before this worksheet is used: `sd.count` refuses on `sd.other_forms` ("Are there gains/losses from Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781, 8824 or Schedule K-1?") and on `sd.carryover` ("Is there a capital loss carryover from the prior year?"), and that refusal reaches Form 1040 line 7a through Schedule D lines 7, 15 and 16, so no return with those items is prepared. No change to the data.

rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. Form 2439 box 1d and Schedule K-1 amounts are refused before this worksheet is used: `sd.count` refuses on `sd.other_forms` ("Are there gains/losses from Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781, 8824 or Schedule K-1?") and on `sd.carryover` ("Is there a capital loss carryover from the prior year?"), and that refusal reaches Form 1040 line 7a through Schedule D lines 7, 15 and 16, so no return with those items is prepared. Line 4 is Form 1099-DIV box 2d alone within the slice. No change to the data.

rulings.model: IRS line 5 says 'Enter your long-term capital loss carryovers from Schedule D, line 14; and Schedule K-1 (Form 1041), box 11, code D'. The program always enters $0, and no refusal excludes filers who have carryovers. A filer with only distributions can still have a carryover.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; project retained. Carryovers are refused before this worksheet is used: `sd.count` refuses on `sd.other_forms` ("Are there gains/losses from Forms 4797, 2439, 6252, 4684, 6781, 8824 or Schedule K-1?") and on `sd.carryover` ("Is there a capital loss carryover from the prior year?"), and that refusal reaches Form 1040 line 7a through Schedule D lines 7, 15 and 16, so no return with those items is prepared. A positive carryover must be subtracted here when carryovers come into scope (recorded in the transcription rulings). No change to the data.
